parts.text: Gas of mass 0.23 g is trapped in a cylinder by a piston. The gas is at atmospheric pressure which is 1.0 × 10 5 Pa. Fig. 4.1 shows the piston held in position by a catch. Fig. 4.1 The volume of the trapped gas is 1.9 × 10 –4 m 3 . An electrical heater is used to increase the temperature of the trapped gas by 550 °C.
